query_vector_precompute.fix: FIX 2: BLEND's content-dimension query vector is the embedding of the trajectory's OWN direct-decode answer. The LANDED M0 arm already flew exactly that decode over exactly this population under the identical derived geometry on the identical service instance, so those texts are embedded ONCE, OFFLINE, before takeoff.
